risk_note: F1-14c (FU-ADMIN-ROUTE-STATUS-PARAM; orchestrator D10-1638 ③, D10-1650, D10-1653). The dashboard cards link to /withdrawals?status=PENDING_REVIEW and /recon?status=open, but the withdrawal review page and the recon difference page did not read the address. Now each page reads `status` from the address once, on entry: a value of the contract enum (WithdrawalStatus / AdminReconDiffStatus, exact case) becomes the initial status filter, the control shows it and the first and only first-screen list read carries status=<value>; a missing, empty or invalid value is ignored (no parameter, no error). After entry the value is just the page's own filter: clearing the select and pressing 查询 sends no status (no fallback to the address value), 重置 clears it, other values work as before; the address is never rewritten and other parameters are not read. No write path, no amount and no step-up are touched; claims, settle-bills and agent/reports already read the address and are unchanged; no card guard (D10-1653: the shell's 尚未接入 placeholder already prevents unknown pages) and no frozen case is modified. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context; ledger tester claude-independent): 14 tests in 2 files; another independent Claude spec-test r1 pass with two S2 (a cleared select falling back to the address value; required in the implementation brief). Red on couli-ci for the spec commit (14 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context), changing only model.ts and the page file of each of the two pages; couli-ci verify:fast run 2 green (30604 spec tests) and --browser run 1 green. Written by hand.
